pages.title: Graviton Harness
pages.text: A web of straps and plates that takes the pull of a crushing field and spreads it through every bone at once, so no single joint bears it. Tidal forces kill by difference, not by strength; the harness erases the difference. Wearing it feels like being hugged by a planet.

$(thing)Notebook$()$(br)A walk through a high-gravity field nearly broke both my ankles. I laid graviton crystals across neutronium plating and added an inertia damper to smooth the gradients, so that the field pulls on all of me equally and none of me in particular.
Made in a crafting grid.$(br2)$(thing)Unlocked by$(): Compactification.
